ingredients.raw: 1 cup cooked quinoa (or ⅓ cup uncooked to boil)
ingredients.name: cooked quinoa

ingredients.raw: 1 can black beans (15 oz/400g) – drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: black beans

ingredients.raw: 1 can butter beans (15 oz/400g) – drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: butter beans

ingredients.raw: ¾ teaspoon salt plus black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: salt and black pepper

instructions.text: Whisk together olive oil, lime juice, honey, mustard, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, and cilantro in a medium bowl until smooth.
Add black beans and butter beans to dressing; toss well and let marinate while preparing other components.
Combine cooked quinoa, bell pepper, corn, red onion, and crumbled feta in a large bowl, keeping separate from beans.
Pour marinated beans and dressing over quinoa mixture; toss until evenly coated. Serve with Greek yogurt and hot sauce if desired.
